key.name: index-roots
key.summary: Comma-separated list of roots to index
key.description: Directories to walk when building the file index. Use absolute paths. Virtual filesystems (/proc, /sys, /dev, /run) are always skipped regardless of this setting.

key.name: skip-dirs
key.summary: Comma-separated list of directories to skip
key.description: Directory paths that should never be crawled even if they appear under an indexed root.

key.name: worker-threads
key.summary: Number of crawler worker threads (0 = auto)

key.name: index-atime
key.summary: Record file access time (atime) in the index

key.name: follow-symlinks
key.summary: Follow symbolic links when crawling (may cause cycles)

key.name: match-path
key.summary: Match search terms against the full path, not just the filename

key.name: enable-regex
key.summary: Interpret the search query as a regular expression

key.name: max-results
key.summary: Maximum number of results to return per search

key.name: db-path
key.summary: Override SQLite index path (empty = default XDG location)
